description:
Versioned software and aggregate-evidence companion for a finite retrospective empirical methods study. The resource preserves 22 fixed claim-estimand objects, 27 historical primary models, 23 absolute-effect sensitivities and 13 dependent historical cross-trial units. Current strict replication proportion is not estimable. AVAglio illustrates source-defined same-trial reanalysis; TRIO illustrates inference restricted by unresolved individual allocation phase. Neither establishes independent validation of a general-purpose tool or a field-wide failure rate.

Source code is MIT licensed. Original documentation, figures, manuscript drafts and derived aggregate tables are CC BY 4.0 under LICENSE-DATA.md; the software record's primary MIT licence does not relicense these components or third-party inputs. Raw participant data, linkage identifiers, third-party full texts, credentials and environments are excluded. Historical AI tool/model details were not fully recorded; known current Codex assistance is disclosed. This record is not an accepted journal article or a completed journal submission.
